views.label: Detection
views.note: The leader stops renewing. Default lease duration3s is an election configuration, not an application recovery deadline.

views.label: Election
views.note: An eligible standby attempts leadership with default retryPeriod1s; API reachability and scheduling still matter.

views.label: Ordered leader setup
views.note: The new leader programs aggregate AWS routes first, then CiliumVTEPConfig endpoints; local tunnel state is already maintained.

segments.label: Ordered setup: AWS routes first, VTEP endpoints second

messages.label: renew lease — fails
messages.note: Election defaults are not a measured recovery time.

messages.label: acquire lease (retryPeriod 1s)
messages.note: Gateway Pod 2 becomes the new leader

messages.label: First: AWS CreateRoute / ReplaceRoute
messages.note: Configured aggregate routes point to the new leader ENI.

messages.label: Then: CiliumVTEPConfig endpoints
messages.note: Update tunnelEndpoint/cidr/mac for Cilium VTEP consumers.

cards.title: Recovery prerequisites
items: Defaults3s lease /2s renew deadline /1s retry are not latency guarantees
Every replica already reconciles local tunnel state
AWS aggregate routes update before VTEP endpoints
Measure API convergence, packet loss and application recovery

cards.title: During the Failover Window
items: VPC-to-hybrid path depends on current AWS routes
Hybrid-to-VPC path depends on the active VTEP endpoint
Intra-hybrid paths bypass the gateway but may share failed infrastructure
